notes: DL102 is a small counter-mount induction (hearing) loop amplifier, not a mainstream video/audio-routing device. Enclosure 3.9"x2.3"x1" (100x60x25mm), 0.48lbs — desktop, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Data pulled directly from Williams AV's own "SPECIFICATION DATA — DL102" PDF datasheet (2-page A/E spec + connector table), which is the most authoritative source and is fully self-consistent, hence confidence=high. Product/family page (https://williamsav.com/product/dl-102/) confirms the same 3-input description and lists bundled-microphone variants (DL102-SY1 boundary mic, SY2 directional mic, SY3 desktop mic) — those are separate SKUs, not part of the base DL102's physical I/O. None of the DL102's connectors fall on a bandwidth-graded scale (no HDMI/SDI/DP/USB/Ethernet), so no "grade" field is set on any port, per spec. Phoenix-style screw terminals (input 1, input 2, loop out) were mapped to the closest available connector id, "euroblock" — physically equivalent pluggable/fixed screw-terminal blocks. The front-panel silkscreen (from the datasheet product photo) reads "MIC / INPUT 1", "LINE MIC / INPUT 2", "LOOP", "POWER IN 12V DC" alongside three rotary gain/level trim pots and two LEDs (green Power, red Loop Current) — those pots/LEDs are not physical I/O ports.

ports.name: Mic In
ports.note: 3.5mm mono electret microphone input (dedicated); mono TS-style jack, closest listed connector id is trs-3.5

ports.name: Input 1
ports.note: 2-pole Phoenix-style screw-terminal block, mic or line level (selectable), with front-panel rotary trim pot; Phoenix terminal mapped to closest enum id 'euroblock'

ports.name: Input 2
ports.note: 3-pole Phoenix-style screw-terminal block, isolated line-level input, with front-panel rotary trim pot

ports.name: Loop
ports.note: 2-pole Phoenix-style screw-terminal loop-drive output; constant-current amplifier delivering 2A RMS (2.8A pk) at 1kHz into a 0.1-1.0Ω loop antenna — not a standard line-level audio output. Has its own rotary trim pot.

ports.name: Power In
ports.note: 12V DC 1.5A barrel input from included external power supply (supply itself rated 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, 2.0A input, for US/international mains)
